test_item_verbatim: RVC2.4) If the system technological constraints prevent the camera from displaying the “X” exit button on the camera image while in DRIVE, the camera delay option will not be supported

tcs.tc_title: the camera delay option is not supported when the X cannot be shown in DRIVE
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The rear view camera cannot display the "X" exit button on the camera image while in DRIVE
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Apps" on Menu Bar to open App Drawer
2. Select "Settings" in the App Drawer
3. Select "Camera"
4. Read the "Camera" list and check that "Rear View Camera Delay" is not offered
tcs.expected_result:
1. The App Drawer is displayed
2. The "Settings" screen is displayed
3. The "Camera" list is displayed
4. "Rear View Camera Delay" is not present in the "Camera" list
tcs.split_reason: the camera delay option is not supported when the X cannot be shown in DRIVE
tcs.test_item:
RVC2.4) If the system technological constraints prevent the camera from displaying the “X” exit button on the camera image while in DRIVE, the camera delay option will not be supported

(the camera delay option is not supported when the X cannot be shown in DRIVE)

reasoning: 本列與 H 本 §6.1.2（`NR1L-RVCHMI-001`）**同旨而非逐字全等** —— 本列有 `RVC2.4)` 之編號前綴，H 本無（分群實測相異）。**兩者之來源本不同**（RVC+PAM vs HeadUnitCameraSystems），依 **R-CAM10** 各自出 TC；**R-CAM16(c) 不適用**（該款以「同組另一列」為要件，本對跨兩本且分屬 `Warning Banners`／`Activation and Exit` 兩組）。前提 3 為車輛配置事實，非可注入之訊號 → 記入 `bench_verify.md`（同 `-001`）。
